div.div:
Paths
The runner and every cluster call the ingress origin, server.public_url: /api/v1 for the scenarios, /worker/v1 and /state/v1 for workers. Signed object URLs are user delegation SAS URLs that Pods fetch from Blob Storage directly.

text.tspan: The runner and every cluster call the ingress origin, server.public_url:
/api/v1 for the scenarios, /worker/v1 and /state/v1 for workers. Signed
object URLs are user delegation SAS URLs that Pods fetch from Blob

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(29, 32, 48), rgb(207, 209, 223)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(58, 63, 85), rgb(178, 182, 201));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 367px; height: 1px; padding-top: 849px; margin-left: 409px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #e6e8f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#e6e8f0, #24252c); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Trust anchors and egress
Everyone trusts system roots: the managed ingress certificate and the Blob Storage endpoint. Each cluster egresses through its own NAT. The app managed identity signs in to PostgreSQL, Blob Storage and Key Vault through Entra ID.

text.tspan: Everyone trusts system roots: the managed ingress certificate and the Blob
Storage endpoint. Each cluster egresses through its own NAT. The app
managed identity signs in to PostgreSQL, Blob Storage and Key Vault

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(29, 32, 48), rgb(207, 209, 223)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(58, 63, 85), rgb(178, 182, 201));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 367px; height: 1px; padding-top: 849px; margin-left: 808px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #e6e8f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#e6e8f0, #24252c); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
For
Ingress, TLS and its certificate come with Container Apps, so there is no load balancer or gateway to run. Entra database authentication, Key Vault keys and user delegation SAS exercise the Azure drivers.

text.tspan: Ingress, TLS and its certificate come with Container Apps, so there is no
load balancer or gateway to run. Entra database authentication, Key Vault
keys and user delegation SAS exercise the Azure drivers.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(29, 32, 48), rgb(207, 209, 223)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(58, 63, 85), rgb(178, 182, 201));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 367px; height: 1px; padding-top: 849px; margin-left: 1207px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #e6e8f0;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#e6e8f0, #24252c); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Against
Private access to the database needs a VNet-integrated environment. A custom domain needs DNS validation. Replicas must stay fixed at two for the scheduler. Remote server coverage needs its own collection.

text.tspan: Private access to the database needs a VNet-integrated environment. A
custom domain needs DNS validation. Replicas must stay fixed at two for
the scheduler. Remote server coverage needs its own collection.
